headline: Exchanges Took In $223 Million, A Turn From A $252 Million Outflow
narrative: Exchanges took in $223 million across assets in the latest day, a turn from an outflow of $252 million. The dollar pipe measures custodied value across all assets, and an inflow means that value arrived on venues where holders can sell. Bitcoin balances on those venues are higher by 6,620 coins over seven days, and bitcoin changed hands near 81k, down 2.94 percent.
author: jordan
